set.summary: After a failed cavalry attack on Caesar's column, Vercingetorix shut himself and 80,000 men in Alesia. Caesar enclosed it with a 11-mile inner line and a 14-mile outer line of ditches, ramparts, towers and booby traps, the stimuli, lilia and cippi. A relief army that Caesar puts at 250,000 foot and 8,000 horse attacked from outside while Vercingetorix attacked from within; the final assault fell on a weak camp on the north side, where Caesar himself, recognisable by his red cloak, led the reserve and German cavalry took the attackers in the rear.

corrections.reason: Caesar BG 7.69: the inner circuit 'XI milia passuum tenebat'; the outer line was 14 miles (7.74).
